data.spec: Live Anthropic input routes directly to generic Claude with tools read_office_status, read_conditions, submit_request(Interpretation), room_request. No model purchase-execution or approval tool. Existing HTTP payloads preserved. Additive SQLite conversation_inputs(id PK,input TEXT,task_id TEXT) preserves input/transcript event retry identity; no credential storage. Existing procurement prepare_need accepts optional validated Interpretation (no second classifier), preserving quote/spend/duplicate/execution checks. RoomQuery adds message_owner/status/cancel; only live Claude-supplied decisions bypass old mock regex routing. Completed conversations resolve; unquoted information/clarification can continue via transcript. Root owns listed core files; no firmware changes.
